name: Video Gallery Block – Display your videos as a gallery in a professional way
author: bPlugins

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor

  1. Go to the WordPress block editor.
  2. Search for Video Gallery Block.
  3. Click to add the block.

Upload Plugin

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload video-gallery-block.zip and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Is Video Gallery Block free?

Yes! The free version includes albums, filters, captions, thumbnails, gallery layouts, and basic styling controls. A Pro version is available for advanced layouts and features.

What extra features are included in Pro?

Pro unlocks sliders, carousels, responsive controls, advanced typography, player styling, Wistia groups, and multiple video sources.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with all modern WordPress themes.

Can I customize the gallery design?

Absolutely. Free users can adjust layout and styling basics, while Pro users get full control over typography, overlays, navigation, and responsiveness.

Can I create multiple video galleries?

Yes, you can create unlimited galleries across your site.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes. The gallery is responsive by default, with device-specific controls available in Pro.

Can I use my own video files?

Yes. You can use YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, and self-hosted HTML5 videos (Pro).

How do I get support?

Free users can use the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users receive priority email support.

sections.description:
Responsive Video Gallery & Lightbox Block for WordPress

Video Gallery Block is a lightweight and flexible WordPress Gutenberg plugin for creating responsive video galleries, grids, and lightbox popups—without writing any code.

Easily display YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia, or self-hosted HTML5 videos in a modern grid layout. Organize videos using albums and filters, and open them in a smooth popup lightbox for an immersive viewing experience.

Perfect for creating video portfolios, testimonial sections, product videos, YouTube galleries, Vimeo showcases, and more—all inside the native Gutenberg block editor.

View Live Demos

Free Features

  • Video Gallery Block: Create responsive video grids.
  • Albums & Filters: Organize videos with filterable albums.
  • Responsive Columns: Control columns for Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile.
  • Video Sources: Support for YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted videos.
  • Custom Styling: Adjust gap, padding, border, background, and shadows.
  • Thumbnails: Automatic generation or custom poster uploads.
  • Captions: Support for video captions on thumbnails and lightbox.
  • Lightbox: Immersive lightbox viewing experience.
  • Optimized Performance: Scripts load only when the block is used.
  • Translation Ready: Fully translatable for multilingual websites.

Pro Features

  • 8 Premium Blocks: Masonry Grid, Video Slider, Carousel, Playlist Gallery, Parallax Row, Testimonial Section, Slider Autoplay, and Lightbox Gallery.
  • Masonry Layout: Perfect for mixing portrait and landscape videos.
  • Sliders & Carousels: Interactive swipes and infinite loops.
  • Playlist Gallery: Detailed playlist layout with side navigation.
  • Parallax Effects: Engaging background video sections.
  • Advanced Styling: Enhanced typography, overlays, and player controls.
  • Custom Controls: Fine-tune navigation, play buttons, and layouts.
  • WooCommerce Product Carousel: Attach products to videos with direct linking.
  • Priority Support: Dedicated support for Pro users.

How to Use

  • Install and activate the Video Gallery Block plugin.
  • Open the Gutenberg editor and add the block from the Video Gallery category.
  • Add videos, assign albums, and customize styles from the settings panel.
  • Publish and enjoy your responsive video gallery!

For installation help, see the Installation tab.
